analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI exiting oversold + early Higher Low recovery
analysis.reason:
4거래일 연속 하락 후 오늘 31.10% 급등하며 RSI 과매도 구간 탈출 시도 중. MACD 히스토그램도 개선되며 바닥 다지기 신호.
주봉 ADX 41.6으로 뚜렷한 추세 유지 중이며, 일봉상 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아진 Higher Low 패턴 형성.
ATR 대비 손절 폭(21,790원)이 현재가 대비 22%로 넓어 손절선 설정에 유의.
analysis.reasonEn:
After 4 consecutive days of decline, today's 31.10% surge attempts to break out of RSI oversold territory. MACD histogram is also improving, signaling bottoming.
Weekly ADX at 41.6 indicates a clear trend. Daily chart forms a Higher Low pattern with the 5-day low exceeding the 20-day low.
Stop loss based on ATR (21,790 KRW) is wide at 22% of the current price, requiring careful stop placement.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200 ($136,408/$96,012) — Below long-term SMA100, above SMA200.

· Swing Resistance ($115,010) — Near 5-day high and Pivot PP ($118,200).

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.93x) — Normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation) — Enter long on confirmation of RSI oversold exit and MACD improvement.
